title: GNU Inetutils FTP Client File Retrieval Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-136613)
description: CVE-2026-136613 is a command injection vulnerability in the GNU Inetutils FTP Client affecting the processing of filenames. It allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by tricking a user into interacting with a malicious FTP server. The flaw arises from insufficient validation of user-supplied strings before executing system calls, enabling code execution with the privileges of the current user. Exploitation requires user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.5.
